title: Agent Orchestrator with Specialized Assistants
description: Build a hierarchical multi-agent system where specialized AI agents are wrapped as tools and coordinated by an orchestrator agent to handle complex, multi-domain queries

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Implements a hierarchical multi-agent system with specialized agents as tools
Uses an orchestrator agent to route and delegate queries to appropriate specialists
Supports research, product recommendations, and trip planning capabilities
Features modular architecture for easy addition of new specialized agents
Handles complex queries across multiple domains through coordinated delegation
